events.event_name: CHANEL COCO MADEMOISELLE CRUSH ABSOLU Event
events.what_it_is: A public COCO MADEMOISELLE CRUSH ABSOLU fragrance experience with personalized fragrance discovery and access to the broader COCO MADEMOISELLE line.
events.what_is_free: Public access to the fragrance experience. Appointments are limited, but CHANEL explicitly encourages walk-ins during event hours.
events.caveats: Appointments are limited; walk-ins are encouraged, so advance booking is optional rather than approval-based. On-site purchases may be available but are not required for entry.
events.practical_notes: Official CHANEL event page confirms September 11–13 and 18–20 at 873 Washington Street. September 12–13 and 19–20 run 10 AM–7 PM; September 18 runs noon–7 PM.

events.address: North Esplanade by The Rink, Rockefeller Center, New York, NY 10111
events.what_it_is: A New York Fashion Week Sally Hansen activation at Rockefeller Center focused on the Miracle Gel Bold Glam collection, with nail touch-ups and photo moments.
events.what_is_free: Public access to the activation, including nail touch-ups and photo moments as available on site.
events.caveats: Rockefeller Center lists the activation as part of its public NYFW programming. No RSVP, ticket, or approval requirement is published for this activation.
events.practical_notes: Saturday, September 12 from 12–6 PM and Sunday, September 13 from 10 AM–6 PM at the North Esplanade by The Rink.

events.what_it_is: A NYFW public pop-up with hair and makeup refreshes, a photo booth, tights customization, coffee, stickers, and on-site shopping.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary coffee, branded stickers, hair and makeup touch-ups, and the photo booth are advertised. Embroidery is free with purchase of 20 Denier Hosiery Knee Highs.
events.caveats: Two current event sources independently describe the pop-up as open to the public. Free embroidery requires purchase of the specified knee-highs; other promotional items and services may be capacity- or supply-limited.
events.practical_notes: September 12–13 from 12–5 PM at 188 Lafayette Street. No RSVP or approval requirement is published in the current event listings.
